544:t_1:3.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Briefing Room ～

544:t_1:5.en:
$$オルソン$$
「Looks like this past week shocked even you, in your own way.」

544:t_1:7.en:
$$オルソン$$
「Ever since the $$大時空震動$$, we've been hunted by all sorts of organizations as $$特異点$$s, and in this multiverse we literally held a singular position...」

544:t_1:8.en:
$$オルソン$$
「Having that denied completely is like having our very existence denied.」

544:t_1:9.en:
$$桂$$
「But at the same time, I realized something. I'd been trying too hard.」

544:t_1:11.en:
$$桂$$
「Just like you said. As a $$特異点$$, I'd convinced myself that I was something special.」

544:t_1:12.en:
$$桂$$
「In short, I was the one treating myself as special.」

544:t_1:13.en:
$$桂$$
「I'm $$桂木桂$$... Just the ace pilot of $c and the handsome boy of the century, that's all, right?」

544:t_1:14.en:
$$オルソン$$
「Even so, you're carrying quite a lot.」

544:t_1:15.en:
$$桂$$
「What about you, $$オルソン$$? Weren't you shocked?」

544:t_1:16.en:
$$オルソン$$
「Unlike you, I know my place. Besides...」

544:t_1:18.en:
$$オルソン$$
「While I was held by the $$サイデリアル$$, a researcher said something about $$特異点$$s...」

544:t_1:20.en:
$$桂$$
「Three... You mean there's one more $$特異点$$ besides you and me?」

544:t_1:21.en:
$$オルソン$$
「That's how we should read it.」

544:t_1:22.en:
$$桂$$
「And if we get that third one, we can somehow handle even a spacetime collapse crisis?」

544:t_1:26.en:
$$桂$$
「I bet that third one is the captive princess we're chasing right now.」

544:t_1:28.en:
$$桂$$
「Yeah, that's right. She... has something a little unusual about her.」

544:t_1:29.en:
$$オルソン$$
「So that's why $$アマルガム$$ went after her...」

544:t_1:33.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Hangar ～

544:t_1:34.en:
$$クルツ$$
「...I owe it all to $$キリコ$$...」

544:t_1:36.en:
$$クルツ$$
「If you trace it back, I might even have you and $$カナメ$$ to thank.」

544:t_1:37.en:
$$宗介$$
「Apparently the virus has damaged your brain.」

544:t_1:38.en:
$$宗介$$
「Go see Lieutenant $$カナリア$$ at once. If it's contagious, it will endanger the entire unit.」

544:t_1:40.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Well... I guess I'd better tell you.」

544:t_1:41.en:
$$宗介$$
「A confession, then... If you'll have me, I'll hear you out.」

544:t_1:42.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Listen, OK? What I'm about to say stays just between us.」

544:t_1:44.en:
$$クルツ$$
「It's, uh... how do I put this... The thing is, I... got carried away talking about $$キリコ$$ and $$フィアナ$$...」

544:t_1:47.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Huh... what do you mean, 'and'... Uh... That's a problem, isn't it?」

544:t_1:48.en:
$$宗介$$
「Were the two of you not dozing off together during a mission?」

544:t_1:49.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Listen! A man and a woman! There's only one answer to that!」

544:t_1:52.en:
$$シェリル$$
「Oh, ha ha... You two get along so well. I'm jealous.」

544:t_1:54.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Ta-talking about that kind of thing in a place like this is the beginning of a breakdown in discipline!」

544:t_1:56.en:
$$テッサ$$
「A-as punishment, Master Sergeant $$ウェーバー$$ is ordered to receive a lecture on the operation from Ensign $$マオ$$ until sortie!」

544:t_1:62.en:
$$シェリル$$
「Some sniper... He never lets his target get away.」

544:t_1:64.en:
$$シェリル$$
「See you, Captain $$テッサ$$. We're on meal duty.」

544:t_1:65.en:
$$ランカ$$
「Good luck with the next operation...」

544:t_1:66.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...Thank you for showing me the way, $$ランカ$$, $$シェリル$$.」

544:t_1:67.en:
$$宗介$$
「...Um... Captain... I apologize for... $$クルツ$$... earlier.」

544:t_1:68.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Please don't worry about it. ...I was a little surprised, though.」

544:t_1:69.en:
$$テッサ$$
「But it's a surprise. I didn't think you would talk about that sort of thing, $$相良$$.」

544:t_1:70.en:
$$宗介$$
「No, it isn't like that. That was $$クルツ$$ going off on his own...」

544:t_1:71.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Hee hee... I got to see you flustered for the first time in a while.」

544:t_1:73.en:
$$テッサ$$
「At $$ヤムスク１１$$, where we are headed, I'm asking you to be my bodyguard. That's why I came to go over the details.」

544:t_1:74.en:
$$宗介$$
「In that case, I would have come to you, Captain...」

544:t_1:75.en:
$$テッサ$$
「It's all right... I just... wanted a change of scenery...」

544:t_1:76.en:
$$宗介$$
(I hear the next operation carries great importance for the strategy against $$アマルガム$$...)

544:t_1:77.en:
$$宗介$$
(The Captain is bearing that pressure... All by herself...)

544:t_1:79.en:
$$宗介$$
「Nothing... I swear to protect you, Captain, with everything I have.」

544:t_1:80.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Thank you. I'm glad I came to visit the hangar.」

544:t_1:81.en:
$$テッサ$$
「While I'm at it, let me ask one selfish favor. May I stay here and watch you work, $$相良$$?」

544:t_1:82.en:
$$宗介$$
「Is the operation briefing all right?」

544:t_1:83.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Truthfully, it can wait until later. To reach our destination we have to pass through the Empire's sphere of influence, so let's think about getting there first.」

544:t_1:85.en:
$$宗介$$
「Understood, $$テッサ$$. Watch as long as you like.」
